nodes.label: ADR 0019: Reconciliation Policy
nodes.rationale: Resources: Payments + Refunds + Application fees (Payouts deferred). Drift policy: alert-only in v1, no auto-fix. Drift rows inserted into payment_drift_log with severity, surfaced in platform-admin UI. Lookback: checkpoint + 24h buffer; per-(org, country, resource_type) row in reconciliation_state stores last_reconciled_at. Severity tiered: missing_in_db <10min=info, >=10min=critical; amount_mismatch/currency_mismatch=critical.
alternatives_rejected: Auto-fix for safe drift kinds (buggy reconciler = silent corruption at scale)
Hourly reconciliation (API rate limits, scale fine with nightly)
Replay via stripe.events.list (that is C.1's role; reconciliation is resource-state check)
